mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops > 2% MoM but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises >10% Y/Y but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) both rise by more than 1% in 6 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise >1% in 6mo but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) both rise by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening consumer sector that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise >2% Y/Y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative >40% of the time.
